ctx.x: Ernesto, yes. He was amazing. He was one of those wiry Italian guys. I think he was originally -- I think he had a shoeshine stand. And one of the guys used to leave his instruments by the shoeshine stand, I think it was Stanley Webb, or somebody like that, would leave them there. Then Ernesto would say, you know the bother I take for you, or something like that. And he just wound up packing everybody's instruments around for them.
